arxiv-2109-06045.title: TOWARDS FAIR PRINCIPLES FOR OPEN HARDWARE
arxiv-2109-06045.creator: Nadica Miljković 1, Ana Trisovic 2, Limor Peer 3
arxiv-2109-06045.description: Abstract The lack of scientific openness is identified as one of the key challenges of computational reproducibility. In addition to Open Data, Free and Open-source Software (FOSS) and Open Hardware (OH) can address this challenge by introducing open policies, standards, and recommendations.

arxiv-2110-05972.title: Dynamics of Spin Helices in the one-dimensional X ​ X XX Model
arxiv-2110-05972.creator: Darren Pereira, Erich J. Mueller
arxiv-2110-05972.description: Abstract Motivated by cold-atom experiments and a desire to understand far-from-equilibrium quantum transport, we analytically study the dynamics of spin helices in the one-dimensional X ​ X XX model. We use a Jordan-Wigner transformation to map the spin chain onto a non-interacting Fermi gas with simple equations of motion.

arxiv-2202-08128.title: Driven polymer translocation into a channel: Iso-flux tension propagation theory and Langevin dynamics simulations
arxiv-2202-08128.creator: Jalal Sarabadani, Ralf Metzler, Tapio Ala-Nissila
arxiv-2202-08128.description: Abstract Iso-flux tension propagation (IFTP) theory and Langevin dynamics (LD) simulations are employed to study the dynamics of channel-driven polymer translocation in which a polymer translocates into a narrow channel and the monomers in the channel experience a driving force f c f_{\rm c} .

arxiv-2209-10052.title: Adapting Pretrained Text-to-Text Models for Long Text Sequences
arxiv-2209-10052.creator: Wenhan Xiong, Anchit Gupta, Shubham Toshniwal Yashar Mehdad , Wen-tau Yih Meta AI {xwhan,anchit,shtoshni,mehdad,scottyih}@fb.com
arxiv-2209-10052.description: Abstract We present an empirical study of adapting an existing pretrained text-to-text model for long-sequence inputs. Through a comprehensive study along three axes of the pretraining pipeline – model architecture, optimization objective, and pretraining corpus, we propose an effective recipe to build long-context models from existing short-context models.

arxiv-2209-11240.title: Detailed study of galaxies with the stellar counter-rotation phenomenon
arxiv-2209-11240.creator: Katkov Ivan
arxiv-2209-11240.description: Abstract The process of galactic disc growing is still not fully understood. In the majority of disk galaxies the gas and stars are located in the same plane and rotate in the same direction. However, there are kinematically peculiar galaxies hosting two counter-rotating stellar discs.

arxiv-2405-00752.title: Clustering Running Titles to Understand the Printing of Early Modern Books
arxiv-2405-00752.creator: Nikolai Vogler, Kartik Goyal, Samuel V. Lemley, D.J. Schuldt, Christopher N. Warren, Max G’Sell, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick
arxiv-2405-00752.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nikolai Vogler, Kartik Goyal, Samuel V. Lemley, D.J. Schuldt, Christopher N. Warren, Max G’Sell, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick. We propose a novel computational approach to automatically analyze the physical process behind printing of early modern letterpress books via clustering the running titles found at the top of their pages.

arxiv-2412-19682.title: A Hybrid Technique for Plant Disease Identification and Localisation in Real-time
arxiv-2412-19682.creator: Mahendra Kumar Gohil a,* , Anirudha Bhattacharjee a,1 , Rwik Rana b,2 , Kishan Lal c,3 , Samir Kumar Biswas d,4 , Nachiketa Tiwari a,5 , Bishakh Bhattacharya a,6 a Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India b Department of Computer Scien
arxiv-2412-19682.description: Abstract Over the past decade, several image-processing methods and algorithms have been proposed for identifying plant diseases based on visual data. DNN (Deep Neural Networks) have recently become popular for this task. Both traditional image processing and DNN-based methods encounter significant performance issues in real-time detection owing to computational limitations and a broad spectrum of plant disease features.

arxiv-2504-16298.title: Modeling of lightcurves from reconnection-powered very high energy flares from M87*
arxiv-2504-16298.creator: Siddhant Solanki, Jordy Davelaar, Bart Ripperda, Alexander Philippov
arxiv-2504-16298.description: Abstract The black hole at the center of M87 is observed to flare regularly in the very high energy (VHE) band, with photon energies ≳ 100 \gtrsim 100 GeV. The rapid variability, which can be as short as 2 2 days in the VHE lightcurve constrains some of the flares to originate close to the black hole.

arxiv-2507-11465.title: Elevating 3D Models: High-Quality Texture and Geometry Refinement from a Low-Quality Model Conference: Special Interest Group on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques Conference Conference Papers ; August 10–14, 2025; Vancouver, BC, Canada Special Interest Group on Computer Graphics and Inter

arxiv-2507-11465.description: Abstract . High-quality 3D assets are essential for various applications in computer graphics and 3D vision but remain scarce due to significant acquisition costs. To address this shortage, we introduce Elevate3D, a novel framework that transforms readily accessible low-quality 3D assets into higher quality.

arxiv-2507-16217.creator: Shahriar Golchin, Yanfei Chen, Rujun Han, Manan Gandhi, Tianli Yu, Swaroop Mishra, Mihai Surdeanu, Rishabh Agarwal, Chen-Yu Lee, Tomas Pfister

In the scope of in-context learning (ICL), this translates into using hundreds/thousands of demonstrations in the input prompt, enabling many-shot ICL.

pmc-10521566.title: Hepatocyte-specific HDAC3 ablation promotes hepatocellular carcinoma in females by suppressing Foxa1/2
pmc-10521566.creator: Yahong Xu, Yongjie Zhu, Zhenru Wu, Shengfu Li, Mingyang Shao, Qing Tao, Qing Xu, Yuwei Chen, Yuke Shu, Menglin Chen, Yongjie Zhou, Yujun Shi
pmc-10521566.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), the most common primary liver cancer, prevails mainly in males and has long been attributed to androgens and higher circumstantial levels of interleukin-6 (IL-6) produced by resident hepatic macrophages.MethodsConstitutively hepatocyte-specific histone deacetylase 3 (HDAC3)-deficient (HDAC3LCKO) mice and constitutively hepatocyte-specific HDAC3 knockout and systemic IL-6 simultaneously ablated (HDAC3LCKO& IL-6−/−) mice were used in our study to explore the causes of sex differences in HCC. Additionally, we performed human HCC tissues with an IHC score.

pmc-10672619.title: Anterior Open Bite Malocclusion: From Clinical Treatment Strategies towards the Dissection of the Genetic Bases of the Disease Using Human and Collaborative Cross Mice Cohorts
pmc-10672619.creator: Iqbal M. Lone, Osayd Zohud, Kareem Midlej, Eva Paddenberg, Sebastian Krohn, Christian Kirschneck, Peter Proff, Nezar Watted, Fuad A. Iraqi
pmc-10672619.description: Anterior open bite malocclusion is a complex dental condition characterized by a lack of contact or overlap between the upper and lower front teeth. It can lead to difficulties with speech, chewing, and biting. Its etiology is multifactorial, involving a combination of genetic, environmental, and developmental factors.

pmc-10741496.title: Trends in Simple and Complex Appendicitis in Children and the Potential Correlation to Common Viral Pathogens—A Retrospective Cohort Study between 2010 and 2019 in The Netherlands
pmc-10741496.creator: Sarah-May M. L. The, Paul van Amstel, Sophie M. Noordzij, Roel Bakx, Taco. S. Bijlsma, Joep. P. M. Derikx, L. W. Ernest van Heurn, Martijn van der Kuip, Ramon R. Gorter
pmc-10741496.description: The aim of this study was to evaluate the annual, seasonal and monthly trends in children with simple and complex appendicitis and their correlation to common viral pathogens in the Netherlands. A consecutive multicenter retrospective cohort study was performed between 2010 and 2019 including children (<18 years) surgically treated for appendicitis.

pmc-11522553.title: Comparison of Glisson traction, soft or rigid cervical collars for the treatment of acute atlantoaxial rotatory subluxation in children: a retrospective study
pmc-11522553.creator: Biao Wang, Weyland Cheng, Zhenwei Li, Fangna Liu, Qianzeng Zhao, Weili Li, Keming Sun
pmc-11522553.description: To examine the clinical effect of different conservative therapies (Glisson traction, soft and rigid cervical collar) in the treatment of children with acute atlantoaxial rotatory subluxation. One hundred and forty-four children with acute atlantoaxial rotatory subluxation treated conservatively at our hospital from June 2017 to June 2022 were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-11564304.title: Oscillatory contractile forces refine endothelial cell-cell interactions for continuous lumen formation governed by Heg1/Ccm1
pmc-11564304.creator: Jianmin Yin, Ludovico Maggi, Cora Wiesner, Markus Affolter, Heinz-Georg Belting
pmc-11564304.description: The formation and organization of complex blood vessel networks rely on various biophysical forces, yet the mechanisms governing endothelial cell-cell interactions under different mechanical inputs are not well understood. Using the dorsal longitudinal anastomotic vessel (DLAV) in zebrafish as a model, we studied the roles of multiple biophysical inputs and cerebral cavernous malformation (CCM)-related genes in angiogenesis.

pmc-12561599.title: Morphometric Traits as Predictors of Body Mass in the Marine Gastropod Semicassis bisulcatum: Insights for Aquaculture and Selective Breeding
pmc-12561599.creator: Dewei Cheng, Yun Chen, Xin Liu, Shiyuan Bao, Xuyang Chen, Ying Qiao, Ersha Dang
pmc-12561599.description: Simple SummaryThe gastropod Semicassis bisulcatum represents a promising candidate for aquaculture. However, essential biological data for establishing selective breeding programs are still lacking. This study quantified morphological and mass traits in wild populations and revealed that mass-related traits, with soft body mass being the most notable, show substantially greater individual variation than morphological traits.

pmc-12821974.title: MicroRNA-107 alleviates ferroptosis-mediated acute kidney injury by regulating the PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway
pmc-12821974.creator: Pengfei Zhao, Zhenghua Wu, Hua Chen
pmc-12821974.description: BackgroundMechanistic pathways and biomarkers need to be explored to elucidate the pathogenesis of acute kidney injury (AKI). This study examined miR-107 expression in AKI and the molecular mechanisms underlying the regulation of ferroptosis-mediated AKI.MethodsThis study included 30 patients with AKI and 30 healthy individuals in the control group.

pmc-13386595.title: Comprehensive genomic characterization of herpes B virus isolated from a wild long-tailed macaque reveals conserved entry mechanisms and zoonotic potential
pmc-13386595.creator: Weena Paungpin, Somjit Chaiwattanarungruengpaisan, Metawee Thongdee, Ladawan Sariya, Krittiga Sapkanarak, Taratorn Kemthong, Worawat Dangsagul, Sarin Suwanpakdee, Witthawat Wiriyarat, Suchinda Malaivijitnond
pmc-13386595.description: Herpes B virus (BV; Macacine alphaherpesvirus 1) is a zoonotic alphaherpesvirus endemic in macaques that can cause severe, often fatal encephalomyelitis in humans. However, genomic data from wild macaque populations remain limited. Here, we report the isolation and genomic characterization of a BV strain from a wild long-tailed macaque (Macaca fascicularis) in Thailand and assess its zoonotic potential.

pmc-13618924.title: Operation Room Pre‐Experience Service Willingness of Surgical Patients: A Mixed Method Research
pmc-13618924.creator: Yuling Zhou, Qingqing Chen, Ting Wang, Chuang Qin, Yuqi Peng, Dan Zhang, Rongzhu Chen, Panpan Qiu, Mingran Xie, Guiqi Song, Lunfang Xie
pmc-13618924.description: AimTo investigate surgical patients' willingness to engage in these services, their specific needs and the factors that influence their willingness.DesignAn exploratory, sequential, mixed‐method study employing semi‐structured interviews and cross‐sectional surveys.MethodsQualitative data were collected from 15 patients via semi‐structured interviews from August to November 2021. Colaizzi's phenomenological analysis was used to analyse interview data.
